t: Emryn - Baby Name Meaning, Origin and Popularity
s: March 21, 2024 - It is believed that military leader Emrys Wledig or Ambrosius Aurelianus, who defended Britain from invading forces in the 5th century, inspired the character of Merlin in the Arthurian tales. Emryn also shares a Greek connection with Ambrosios or Ambrose. Also meaning "immortal," Ambrose was considered the nectar of the gods in Greek mythology and created everlasting life in any human who drank it.
